n-k-k5-01.title: Ngaba isaziso siyamxhasa uMinseo?
n-k-k5-01.goal: Hlola ibango lomhlobo ngeemeko zonke zesaziso, hayi eyokuqala kuphela, uze uchaze isiphumo ngesiKorean.
n-k-k5-01.material:
Isaziso sevenkile esikwi-intanethi nomyalezo ovela kumhlobo wakho uMinseo. Namhlanje ngowe-12 kuJulayi.

[여름맞이 이벤트 안내]
- 기간: 7월 1일 ~ 7월 15일
- 이벤트 기간에 3만 원 이상 사시면 배송비가 무료입니다.
- 제주·도서산간 지역은 무료 배송 대상이 아닙니다. (배송비 3,000원)
- 할인 쿠폰은 한 번만 쓸 수 있습니다.

민서의 문자: "나 어제 4만 원어치 샀어! 배송비 무료래. 제주도에 계신 우리 할머니 댁으로 보냈는데 잘됐지?"
n-k-k5-01.prereq.1: Uyazi amanani anjenge 만 원 kunye 삼천 원
n-k-k5-01.prereq.2: Uyazi ukuba 도서산간 = iziqithi ezikude neendawo zeentaba
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.prompt: Ukugqiba ukuba ibango likaMinseo liyinyani na, ziziphi iinkqubo zesaziso ekufuneka uzithelekise nomyalezo wakhe? Khetha zonke ezibalulekileyo.
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ziziphi iinyani zomyalezo kaMinseo ezithethwa sisaziso? Khangela umgca weenyani ngazinye.
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kumgca ngamnye wesaziso, buza: ingaba ubeka imeko yokuthunyelwa simahla?
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.a: Umthetho wekhuphoni ngokwehliswa kwamaxabiso. Ibango likaMinseo ngentlawulo yokuthunyelwa, ngoko lo mgca awunqumi.
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.explain: Ibango lakhe lineenxalenye ezintathu: xa athenge (ixesha lomsitho), kangakanani (30,000 won okanye ngaphezulu) nalapho kuthunyelwe khona (umthetho wommandla). Inxalenye nganye ibandakanywe ngumgca omnye; umgca wekhuphoni awumalunga nokuthunyelwa.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.prompt: Ngaba isaziso siyalixhasa ibango likaMinseo lokuba ukuthunyelwa kwakhe kuyimahala?
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.hint.0: Thatha iimeko zesaziso enye nenye uphawule nganye ngokuthelekisa nomyalezo wakhe.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.a: Ewe, kodwa ukuba usebenzise ikhuphoni yokuhlisa exhaswa kube kanye kuphela.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.r.a: Ikhuphoni yinkonzo eyahlukileyo; asiyiyo imeko yokuthunyelwa simahla.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.b: Akwazeki, kuba nguMinseo kuphela owaziyo ukuba ngokwenene uhlawule malini.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.r.b: Isixa sikumyalezo wakhe, yaye isaziso sibiza imimandla esiyigqibayo, ngoko isigqibo siyenzeka.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.c: Ewe. Uthenge nge-40,000 won ngexesha lomsitho, ngoko ukuthunyelwa kuyimahala.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.r.c: Uhlolile umhla nesixa, kodwa wema apho. Isaziso sineyona imeko enye ngalapho iparsile iya khona.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.d: Hayi. Isaziso asinikezi ukuthunyelwa simahla kummandla awuthumele kuwo.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.explain: Ukuthunyelwa simahla kufuna ixesha lomsitho KUNYE no-30,000 won okanye ngaphezulu KUNYE nommandla wokuthumela ongagqitywanga. UMinseo uyayifezekisa yokuqala neyesibini, kodwa isaziso sigqiba 제주·도서산간. Ukuhlangabezana nemeko yokuqala akwenzi ibango libe yinyani.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.prompt: Phendula uMinseo ngesiKorean (intetho yobuhlobo -요). Yithi ucinga ntoni ngentlawulo yakhe yokuthunyelwa uze unike isizathu esivela kwisaziso. IsiNgesi siyamkelekile ukuba uyabambeka.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngendawo, emva koko uthi isaziso senza ntoni ngaloo ndawo.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.hint.1: Gqibela ngento uMinseo ekufuneka ayilindele ukuyihlawula.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndiyisekele esazisweni hayi ekuqikeleleni kwam kuphela?
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.model.2: Ndicinga ukuba ayimahala: isaziso sithi iJeju ayibandakanywanga, ngoko kusenokubakho intlawulo ye-3,000 won.

n-k-k5-03.title: Ukubhukisha okuhambelana nawo onke amathethwa
n-k-k5-03.topic: iimeko ezininzi ngaxeshanye, enye ifihlakele kwintetho
n-k-k5-03.goal: Guqula isaziso esinomthetho ongalawulwayo sibe yimeko ezichanekileyo, ufumane iibhukisho ezininzi ezanelisa zonke, uze uxele enye ngesiKorean.
n-k-k5-03.material:
Ubhukisha isifundo semyuziyam seentsapho zakho. Isaziso semyuziyam nombhalo wasemakazi wakho:

[가족 체험 예약 안내]
- 요금: 어른 1명 8,000원, 어린이 1명 5,000원
- 한 번에 4명 이상 6명 이하까지 예약할 수 있습니다.
- 어른이 어린이보다 적으면 안 됩니다.
- 어린이는 1명 이상 있어야 합니다.

이모 문자: "예산은 4만 원까지예요."
n-k-k5-03.thinking.0: Ukufunda ngokufanelekileyo umthetho ongalawulwayo (적으면 안 되다)
n-k-k5-03.prereq.0: Uyazi amanani, 명, 원 kunye 이상 / 이하
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.prompt: Isaziso sithi '어른이 어린이보다 적으면 안 됩니다.' Zeziphi iibhukisho ezivunyelwe ngulo mthetho?
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.hint.0: Guqulela umthetho ube ngumthetho ngabantu abadala: 'abantu abadala akufuneki babe ... kunabantwana'.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.hint.1: Bhala umthetho njengoqhagamshelwano phakathi kwenani labantu abadala nelabantwana, uze uwuvavanye kwiimeko apho amanani omabini ahluke khona nalapho alinganayo khona.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.a: Abantu abadala abalingana nenani labantwana, kungabikho enye imixube.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.r.a: Lo mthetho ukhuthaza kuphela abantu abadala ABANCINCI. Abantu abadala abaninzi nabo bamkelekile.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.b: Abantu abadala abalingana nabantwana, okanye abantu abadala abaninzi kunabantwana.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.c: Abantu abadala abaninzi kunabantwana; inani elilinganayo alivunyelwe.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.r.c: Amanani alinganayo ayiyo 'abantu abadala abancinci', ngoko avunyelwe.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.d: Abantwana abaninzi kunabantu abadala; inani elilinganayo alivunyelwe.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.explain: '적으면 안 되다' ithetha 'akufanele babe bambalwa'. Ngoko abantu abadala >= abantwana: abantu abadala abaninzi kuyamkeleka, nenani elilinganayo liyamkeleka, kodwa abantu abadala abambalwa akuvunyelwe.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.prompt: Fumana iibhukisho ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo ezilandela yonke imithetho yesaziso nebhajethi esemyalezweni. a = inani labantu abadala, c = inani labantwana.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.0: Dwelisa imithetho njengeemeko ezimfutshane ku-a no-c phambi kokuba uzame amanani.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.1: Zama ibhukisho enye uyihlole kumthetho ngamnye ngokulandelelana; ukuba omnye umthetho uyasilela, tshintsha a okanye c uphinde uhlole.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.2: Hlola imali ekugqibeleni: 8,000 x a + 5,000 x c.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c1: 어린이는 1명 이상 있어야 합니다: ubuncinane umntwana oyedwa.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c2: 어른이 어린이보다 적으면 안 됩니다: abantu abadala akufuneki babe bambalwa kunabantwana.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c3: 4명 이상: ubuncinane abantu aba-4 ngokwamanani apheleleyo.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c4: 6명 이하: ubukhulu abantu abangama-6 ngokwamanani apheleleyo.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c5: Isixa sigqithisa i-40,000 won (8,000 ngomntu omdala ngamnye, 5,000 ngomntwana ngamnye).
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.explain: Iibhukisho ezintlanu ziyahambelana: (abantu abadala aba-3, umntwana o-1) 29,000 won; (2, 2) 26,000 won; (4, 1) 37,000 won; (3, 2) 34,000 won; (3, 3) 39,000 won. Isaziso nomyalezo banika imida, hayi i-odolo enye echanekileyo.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Khetha IBHUKISHO ENYE yakho uze ubhale isicelo ngesiKorean (-요 ehloniphekileyo) kumyuziyam: bangaphi abantu abadala, bangaphi abantwana, kunye nexabiso lilonke.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Qala ngenani labantu abadala, emva koko abantwana.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Chaza isixa ekugqibeleni uze ugqibele nge-요.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ngaba amanani ahambelana nebhukisho enye endiyakhileyo?
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ngaba isixa silungile (8,000 ngomntu omdala ngamnye + 5,000 ngomntwana ngamnye)?

n-k-k5-02.title: UHayun udlulisa amazwi kautitshala
n-k-k5-02.goal: Thelekisa umyalezo odluliselweyo nowokuqala, ufumane imigca etshintshe intsingiselo yawo, uze uyilungise ngentetho ethethwe ngomnye.
n-k-k5-02.material:
Utitshala unike eli phawu kwiklasi namhlanje (ngoLwesibini). UHayun ebekweklasi. 민수 ebengekho waza wambuza ukuba utitshala uthini, ngoko uHayun umthumelela umyalezo ngobo busuku bunye emva kwemini. (-대 / -래 zithetha 'ndiyive ukuba ...': zidlulisa amazwi omnye umntu. 벼룩시장 = imarike yezinto ezindala.)

[선생님 말씀]
"토요일 학교 벼룩시장은 비가 오면 체육관에서 합니다. 물건은 한 사람이 다섯 개까지 팔 수 있어요. 가격표는 학교에서 준비하니까 안 만들어 와도 돼요. 아침 9시 30분까지 체육관에 물건을 가져다 놓으세요. 팔고 남은 물건은 집에 가져가세요. 참가 신청서는 목요일까지 내세요."
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.prompt: Umyalezo kaHayun kufuneka udlulise ngokuchanekileyo oko utitshala akuthethileyo. Imigca eliqela itshintsha intsingiselo kautitshala. Khetha omnye wayo.
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.hint.0: Thatha umyalezo kautitshala sivakalisi ngesivakalisi ufumane umgca ohambelanayo kumyalezo kaHayun.
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.hint.1: Kumbini ngamnye, thelekisa amanani, iintsuku nokuba intsingiselo ithi 'unokukwenza', 'kufuneka' okanye 'akukho mfuneko'.
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.explain: Imigca 3, 5 no-7 ayichanekanga. Umgca 3 utshintsha 'ukuya kuthi ga kwisihlanu' (다섯 개까지 팔 수 있어요) ube 'kufuneka uthengise ezintlanu'. Umgca 5 utshintsha u-9:30 ube ngu-8:30. Umgca 7 utshintsha umhla wokugqibela kuLwesine ube nguLwesihlanu. Eminye imigca ihambelana namazwi kautitshala.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.prompt: Yeyiphi inguqulelo yomgca 3 edlulisa oko utitshala akuthethileyo ngenani lezinto?
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.hint.0: Qala uthi isivakalisi sikatitshala ngezinto ngamazwi akho: isihlanu sisona sikhulu, sisona sincinci, okanye linani elichanekileyo?
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.hint.1: Vavanya inketho nganye ngolo ntsingiselo uze uthelekise iziphelo (-아/어야 하다 kunye -(으)ㄹ 수 있다).
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.r.b: Oku kuthi kufuneka uthengise ezintlanu ncam. Utitshala unike umda, hayi inani elifunekayo.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.r.c: 이상 itshintsha umda ube sisona sincinci, esiphikisana 'nokuya kuthi ga kwisihlanu'.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.r.d: Oku kuthi ukuthengisa akuvunyelwe kwaphela; utitshala wavumela ukuya kuthi ga kwisihlanu.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.explain: '다섯 개까지 팔 수 있어요' (unokuthengisa ukuya kuthi ga kwisihlanu) kudluliselwa njenge '다섯 개까지 팔 수 있대'. Eyona nkulu, eyona incinci nenani elichanekileyo yimiyalezo emithathu eyahlukeneyo.
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala iinguqulelo ezilungisiweyo zomgca 5 (ixesha lokuzisa izinto) nomgca 7 (umhla wokugqibela wefom) ngesiKorean njengoko uHayun ebenokuthumela 민수 (emva kwemini enye, edlulisa amazwi kautitshala).
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.hint.0: Khuphela amanani nosuku kumyalezo kautitshala, hayi kumyalezo kaHayun.
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.hint.1: Sebenzisa intetho edluliselweyo (umzekelo -대/-래 okanye -라고 했어), njengakwimigca elungileyo.
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba izivakalisi zam ezimbini ziphela njengentetho edluliselweyo (-대/-래/-라고 했어)?
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba 민수 ebeya kufika ngexesha aze angenise ifom ngosuku olufanelekileyo?

n-k-k5-04.title: Ngowuphi usuku lomhla wokugqibela?
n-k-k5-04.goal: Funda umyalezo womhla wokugqibela ngononophelo, ukhethe umbuzo oya kugqiba oko kufuneka ukwenze, uze ubhale lo mbuzo ngembeko.
n-k-k5-04.material:
Namhlanje ngoMvulo, 11월 2일. Utitshala wakho uthumela lo myalezo kwincoko yeklasi.

선생님: "발표 자료는 금요일 전까지 메일로 보내 주세요. 파일 이름에는 이름을 꼭 써 주세요."

Uceba ukugqiba izilayidi zakho ngoLwesihlanu ekuseni.
n-k-k5-04.prereq.1: Udibene ne-전에 / -까지 nentetho enentlonipho okanye yembeko kutitshala
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.prompt: Uceba ukugqiba ii-slide zakho ngoLwesihlanu ekuseni. Phambi kokugqiba, ngowuphi umbuzo ononcedo olukhulu ekubeni ubuzwe utitshala?
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.hint.0: Funda isivakalisi somhla wokugqibela ngokucotha. Liliphi igama kuso elinokufundwa ngeendlela ezimbini?
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.hint.1: Yeyiphi kwimibuzo enokutshintsha oko ukwenzayo ngoLwesihlanu ekuseni?
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.a: Inani lee-slide alilongxaki; umyalezo ushiya omnye umbuzo uvulekile.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.b: Umyalezo sele ukuxelela ukuba ubhale ntoni kwigama lefayile.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.d: Namhlanje nguMvulo 11월 2일, ngoko uLwesihlanu sele luyaziwa (11월 6일).
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.e: Oku kucinga ukuba ukuthumela ngoLwesihlanu kuyavunyelwa. Kanye oko umyalezo ukushiya ungacacanga.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.explain: '금요일 전까지' inokuthetha 'ukuya kutsho kusuku olungaphambi koLwesihlanu' okanye 'ngoLwesihlanu'. Utitshala kuphela owaziyo, ngoko umbuzo ononcedo ubuza ukuba uLwesihlanu ngokwalo luyabalwa na.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.acc.0: Utitshala ophendula 'ukuya kutsho kwiyure yantoni ngoLwesihlanu' wayeza kuyiqukumbela ngokwenyani, kodwa umbuzo awuhloli kuqala ukuba uLwesihlanu luyabalwa.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.prompt: Bhala umbuzo wakho kutitshala ngesiKorean (intetho enentlonipho, yembeko). Khankanya umhla wokugqibela uze uthi ngokucacileyo ofuna ukuyiqinisekisa.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.hint.0: Khankanya amagama omhla wokugqibela kutitshala, uze uthi akuqinisekanga ngasiphi isuku.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.hint.1: Biza utitshala (선생님) ugqibe ngentetho ye--요 okanye -ㅂ니다.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ngaba umbuzo wam ubonisa ukuba ndibona iindlela ezimbini zokufunda ezinokwenzeka?
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ngaba utitshala unokuyiphendula ngesivakalisi esinye esifutshane?
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.prompt: Utitshala uphendula: '아, 금요일 오전 9시까지요.' Kutheni kwakufanelekile ukubuza?
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.hint.0: Thelekisa oko ubucinga ngaphambi kokubuza nempendulo oyifumeneyo.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.hint.1: Zibuze: ingaba umfundi onengqiqo wayenokulifunda ngenye indlela eli xesha?
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.a: Utitshala wenze impazamo ekuchongeni usuku wathetha uLwesithathu.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.r.a: Akukho nto kumyalezo ikhomba kuLwesithathu, kwaye impendulo inika umhla wokugqibela woLwesihlanu.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.b: Zombini uLwesine noLwesihlanu zazizindlela zokufunda ezifanelekileyo, ngoko utitshala kuphela owayenokuqukumbela.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.c: '전까지' ihlala ishiya usuku olubizwayo ngaphandle, ngoko uLwesine lwalusosuku lokugqibela.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.r.c: Impendulo ibonisa ukuba uLwesihlanu ekuseni lwaluvumelekile, kwaye abathethi abaninzi basebenzisa '전까지' ngokukhululekileyo. Ayingomthetho omiselweyo.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.d: '까지' ihlala ibandakanya usuku olubizwayo, ngoko uLwesihlanu lwaluvumelekile ukususela ekuqaleni.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.r.d: Ukuba oko kuhlala kuyinyani, ngekungadingekanga mbuzo; impendulo yongeza nexesha (오전 9시) elingazange linikwe ngumyalezo.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.explain: Isivakalisi esifanayo sinokuthetha 'ngoLwesine' okanye 'ngoLwesihlanu'. Ukusifunda ngendlela enye kuphela kwakubeka ifayile ephoxileyo emngciphekweni. Impendulo yongeza nexesha (오전 9시) elingazange linikwe ngumyalezo.

n-k-k5-05.title: Ukusuka kwincoko yabahlobo ukuya kwisaziso sebhokisi yokunyusa
n-k-k5-05.goal: Phinda ubhale umyalezo wencoko kubantu abangamaziyo ngokongeza ulwazi abahlobo sele bebelana ngalo uze utshintshe isimbo sentetho.
n-k-k5-05.material:
Wena nomhlali kunye nawe niqhuba ipati yokufudukela endlini entsha (집들이) kwifulethi yenu 502호 ngoMgqibelo olandelayo, 10월 24일, ukusuka ku-6 ukuya kwisi-9 p.m. Ubhale oku kwingxoxo yabahlobo bakho:

"토욜 저녁에 우리집 파티함ㅋㅋ 좀 시끄러울 듯. 이해 ㄱㄱ"

(ㅋㅋ = ukohlwa, ㄱㄱ = 'hamba / kulungile', 토욜 = 토요일.) Ngoku ufuna ukubeka isaziso kwibhokisi yokunyusa abamelwane. Abaninzi bakhulile, kwaye awubazi abaninzi.
n-k-k5-05.thinking.1: Ukukhetha isimbo sentetho kubantu abangaziwayo beminyaka eyahlukileyo
n-k-k5-05.prereq.1: Udibene ne-양해, 죄송, 부탁 okanye ungazifunda kwizalathiso
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.prompt: Abahlobo bayazi apho uhlala khona nokuba ipati yeyiphi imini. Abamelwane abangazanga badibane nawe abazi. Zeziphi izinto isaziso sebhokisi yokunyusa esimele sizongeze? Khetha zonke ezisebenzayo.
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga ngokufunda umyalezo wencoko njengomamelwane: yintoni ongayaziyo?
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.hint.1: Abamelwane basenokucaphuka ngengxolo. Bangafuna ukuva ntoni kuwe?
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.o.b: Xa ipati iqala nokuba iphela nini
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.explain: Abamelwane kufuneka bazi ukuba ngubani owenza ingxolo (ifulethi), kangakanani (ixesha lokuqala nelokuphela) nokuba uyabahlonipha (uxolo nesicelo). Imenyu noluhlu lweendwendwe zinomdla kubahlobo kuphela.
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.prompt: Umfundi ubhale uqikelelo lokuqala lwesaziso. Umgca omnye awufanelekanga kubamelwane obungabaziyo, kubandakanya abantu abadala. Wukhethe.
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.hint.0: Funda umgca ngamnye njengomamelwane omdala. Wuphi ovakala usuka kumhlobo?
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.hint.1: Jonga indlela ezinye izicelo kuqikelelo ezibhalwe ngayo.
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.explain: Umgca wesi-4 ucela abamelwane into ngendlela elula, enobuhlobo, engekho semthethweni ('이해해 줘요'). Kubantu ongabaziyo, cela nge-'주세요 / 주시면 감사하겠습니다', umz. '이해해 주시면 감사하겠습니다'.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.prompt: Ngoku bhala wena isaziso sonke ngesiKorean sebhokisi yokunyusa. Bandakanya ifulethi yakho, amaxesha okuqala nokuphela, kunye noxolo okanye isicelo sokuqonda. Sebenzisa intetho enentlonipho yesaziso.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ngokubulisa nefulethi yakho, njengakwisaziso sokwenene.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.hint.1: Beka iinyani (nini, yintoni) kwisivakalisi esinye, emva koko uxolo kwesilandelayo.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ngaba mamelwane ongazanga adibane nam wayeya kwazi ukuba yifulethi kabani kwaye iphela nini?
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ngaba isicelo sam sivakala sihlonipha umntu omdala?
